business_area__c = 'VT' AND IsDuplicate__c = false AND ((type__c IN ('Purchase Plan - fixed rate', 'Purchase Plan - variable rate', 'Operating Lease', 'Operating Lease - fixed rate', 'Finance Lease - fixed rate', 'Contract Hire', 'Hire Purchase IE', 'Finance Lease', 'EaaS Operating Lease NGC', 'Financial Lease NGC', 'Full service leasing NGC', 'Operating Lease NGC') AND account__r.billingcountrycode IN ('GB', 'DK', 'IE')) OR ( type__c IN ('EaaS Operating Lease NGC', 'Financial Lease NGC', 'Instalment credit NGC', 'Operating Lease NGC' ) AND account__r.billingcountrycode ='SE' ) OR ( type__c IN ('Comfort Lease', 'Credit', 'Financiële Lease', 'Flexirent / Truck Rent', 'Global Truck / Service Rent') AND account__r.billingcountrycode ='BE' ) OR ( type__c IN ('Financiële Lease', 'Financiële Lease met Koopoptie', 'Financiële Service Lease', 'Operationele Lease') AND account__r.billingcountrycode ='NL' AND DealerId__c !=null ) OR ( type__c IN ('Financial Lease NGC','Installment Credits NGC','Operating Lease NGC') AND account__r.billingcountrycode ='FI' ) OR ( Type__c IN ('DIRETTO','LEASING','OPERATIVO') AND Account__r.BillingCountryCode ='IT')) AND ( vtcontext_lastmodifieddate__c = last_n_days:lastNDays OR createddate = last_n_days:lastNDays)
